Confidence moderate: only one buffer and a second (non-prominent) strong anionic argue for strong, the realistic neighbor.

conditioningLevel.rationale: C2 not met: Dimethiconol #11 and Dimethicone #14 sit after Parfum #6 (not early; supporting routes only), no prominent payload lipid. Other elements present: Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #13 (cationic), Glycol Distearate #9 (pearlizer), Glycerin #21/Panthenol #24 (R11 humectants). One meaningful system (guar/silicone coacervate) plus light/supporting routes -> moderate. Counter-signal: two silicones plus guar is a deposition-oriented system, so high is the realistic neighbor.
